title: The Grape Escape
specs: All rooms are private and suitable for all ages
Three main themed rooms: Moonstone Apothecary, Temple of Razum, Kraken Casino
Games feature special effects including sudden lighting and sound changes
Players 6 and older must be booked; kids under 5 assist free
Participants under 14 must be accompanied by an adult inside the room
All participants must sign a waiver upon arrival
No intoxicated participants allowed; will be turned away without refund
Players must be able to crawl and move comfortably
Children under 6 assist free but must be accompanied by an adult
Private bookings available; up to three rooms per party depending on availability

blurb: Guests participate in themed escape room games where they solve puzzles and find clues to escape within 60 minutes. The experience includes a safety briefing and debriefing, lasting about 1.5 hours total. Rooms are private and suitable for all ages, with children under 15 requiring adult accompaniment.
extraNote: Tickets are non-refundable; rescheduling allowed 48 hours in advance · Late arrivals allowed but game time reduced accordingly; no extensions · If game moderator deems participant intoxicated, no play and no refund · Events not reserved until full payment is received
